scientific_integrity: Exact all-order mathematical argument is supplied; independent finite enumeration stress tests only, not an infinite proof. Original published sources are distinguished from the new statements.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple labelled uniform windmills K_1 join m copies of K_(r-1), r>=3 and m>=2, using q named colors and iterative local chromatic forcing; not a formula for arbitrary block graphs, ordinary zero forcing, or unique-extension forcing. Prior results under unindexed terminology remain a risk.
title: Exact palette-sensitive forced-colouring polynomials of clique windmills
